standard-dialogue.player: Hello there. What are you doing here?

standard-dialogue.npc: I'm waiting here hoping that someone can guide me to the Paterdomus, the temple on the Salve.

steps.npc: Oh, Paterdomus is that rather impressive looking temple on the Salve... I'm sure you must have passed it on your way into Morytania.

options.text: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?

steps.player: Why do you want to go to Paterdomus?

steps.npc: I'm hoping to get back to civilisation and see what the lands of Misthalin look like.
Well, now that the vampyres aren't a problem, I reckon there might be a hope of actually making it through the swamps and starting a new life over in Misthalin.

options.text: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies...?

steps.player: Could you defend yourself if we met enemies on the route to Paterdomus?

steps.npc: Let's just say that I'm somewhat experienced and I'm happy to take on my fair share of bad guys. You don't need to worry about that.

options.text: I can take you to Paterdomus.

steps.player: I can take you to Paterdomus.

steps.text: If the player has a follower:

steps.npc: Hmmm, it seems that you have a follower. I think it may get lost on this journey if it's left to wander on its own. Let's leave when your follower is safe.
Oh really? That would be great! I'll give you a small reward once we reach our destination.
Ok, which route should we take?

steps.text: (Temple Trekking choose a route interface opens

standard-dialogue-when-a-piece-of-accept.npc: Ah, so you want to give me some supplies, eh? Let me just open me backpack.

steps.npc: Oh, I hate this trip, but it's better than staying in Burgh de Rott.
When are we going to get to Paterdomus?
We don't have all day to stand around chatting; let's press on.
Do you visit Paterdomus often? You seem to know the route well.

temple-trekking-dialogue-if-the-player-o.npc: Can't you see I'm being attacked...?

temple-trekking-dialogue-when-a-piece-of.npc: Thanks, I'll get this down my neck.

temple-trekking-dialogue-bridge-event.npc: Blimey! Looks like we're going to have to go back to Burgh de Rott. We can't get over that bridge!

temple-trekking-dialogue-bridge-event.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

temple-trekking-dialogue-bog-event.npc: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.

temple-trekking-dialogue-bog-event.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way!

temple-trekking-dialogue-bog-event.npc: Hey...that's great...you did a great job...I'll follow you.
But we really should be heading off now.

temple-trekking-dialogue-river-event.npc: Well that's torn it... Looks like we can't get over this bog. We'll have to go back to Burgh de Rott.

temple-trekking-dialogue-river-event.player: Oh, I'm sure we can find a way through!

temple-trekking-dialogue-river-event.npc: That's amazing! I'll have to do the same.
Whahay! That was great! But we really should be heading off now.

temple-trekking-dialogue-tentacle-event.npc: Ahhh, that would be a tentacle...
I think I'm going to faint!
Blimey! Look at that beast! You're gonna have to sort that thing out on your own!

temple-trekking-dialogue-finishing-a-tre.npc: Many thanks for getting me safely to the temple. Here's your reward.

temple-trekking-dialogue-finishing-a-tre.text: Dalcian Fang gives you a reward token!
